fields.h1: Build a Return Authorization Form Template With RA Numbers
fields.hero_description: Build a return authorization form template that checks each order's return window and emails an RA number when it passes.
fields.features_heading: Every Return Request, Checked Against the Order
fields.features_subheading: A downloaded template collects a request and stops. Here, the app reads the order behind it and numbers the return.
fields.feature_1:
Describe your policy, get the form behind it

Describe your return policy and the products it covers. Emergent builds the request form, the returns table and the staff dashboard, then changes them when you prompt again.
fields.feature_2:
Order details pulled in, not retyped

Connect the store platform your orders run through. The customer types an order number, and the app reads the items and the delivery date through that platform's API.
fields.feature_3:
Questions that follow the reason picked

Pick damaged in transit and the form asks which part broke. Pick wrong item and it asks what arrived instead. Changed my mind skips both and goes to the return address.
fields.feature_4:
RA numbers your dock can match

Each approved request takes the next number in the series and prints it on the return instructions. At the dock, typing that number opens the request beside its order.
fields.feature_5:
A Slack ping when a person has to decide

Requests that fail a rule wait in a review list, and Slack or email tells the right person, with a link to the request. Customer names and addresses stay in the database.
fields.feature_6:
Your returns data, your database

Every request, decision and inspection result lands in a database you own, with no cap on responses. On paid plans, export the full code to your own GitHub repository.
fields.why_description: Emergent builds the returns app from a plain-English description of your policy. The free tier covers building and publishing it.

fields.hero_prompt: Build a return authorization form template for my cookware store that checks the delivery date against a 30-day window and emails an RA number.

faq_plan.q: What is a return authorization form template?
How do I create a return authorization form template?

plan.angle: The top 10 for return authorization form template are Word, PDF and Excel downloads (business-in-a-box, template.net, pdfFiller, DocHub) and RMA form templates from form tools (WPForms, Jotform, 123FormBuilder) that collect a request and stop there. This page shows the form as a working returns app: the customer's request is checked against the order and the return window, an in-window request gets its RA number by email, a late one waits for a support lead, the dock records condition and the restocking fee, and every request feeds a reasons report, all in a database the store owns.
tab_stories: Gwyneira Branscombe asks Hearthwell Cookware to return a Dutch oven that arrived with a cracked lid 9 days after delivery, and inside the 30-day window the app issues RA-1047 and emails her the number and the return address.

Osmund Treadwell asks Copperbrook Cycle Supply to return 6 brake sets 44 days after delivery, past the 30-day window, so the request waits for support lead Lisbeth Marchetti-Ross, and Slack posts her a link to it.
At Stonechat Outdoor's dock, Ines Coldharbour scans RA-2290 on a returned $240 tent, marks it opened with all parts present, and the 15% restocking fee rule leaves a $204 store credit for approval.
Brightwater Footwear's October returns report shows 18 returns of the Trail Runner, 11 of them marked runs small, 4 damaged in transit and 3 changed my mind.
